edits.description: Restored the complete contiguous 24-bit implementation. Retained the released header, applicable history, routine contracts, symbolic operands, and matching instruction comments. The historical header describes a later source file; it does not date this reconstruction.

Matched instructions within corresponding released 24-bit routines using resolved equates and operand values. The ROM determines branch targets, widths, direct calls, and instruction encodings. A recorded source operation may have a different encoding in the later source. Omitted comments about removed patches and dispatch vectors.

Replaced build includes and address-mode dispatch with the required released equates and explicit external ROM addresses. Expanded GetZ and SetZ as their MOVE instructions. Declared A-line traps with OPWORD. Preserved PC addressing and the ROM instruction widths.

Restored the masked-pointer DerefHandle and WhichZone routines, ZoneCheck register save, direct prologues, and epilogues. This ROM has no later bus-error handlers, memory-mode retries, or dispatch-vector frames.
Retained the 24-bit purge, compact, allocate, resize, grow-zone, master-pointer, and relocation algorithms. Restored the original rover updates and control flow where later patches changed them.

ActualS adds the eight-byte block header, rounds to an even size, and enforces a 12-byte minimum. SetSize has no later first-master-pointer padding or 68040 alignment path. HBlockMove calls the ROM BlockMove body directly.
Restored ToMaxLimit, MaxLimit, and StdGZ with their ROM register contracts. StdGZ reserves memory through the ResrvMem trap and preserves grow-zone state before calling the user grow-zone procedure.
